idea-plugin.name: Copy To Scratch
idea-plugin.description: Copies the current text selection and inserts it at the cursor position in the most recently accessed scratch file, without switching focus.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Initial release
  • Copy selection to the last opened scratch file
  • Keyboard shortcut support (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V / Cmd+Alt+Ctrl+V on Mac)

action.description: Copies selected text to the caret position in the last opened scratch file
